name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
_note_future_trigger: This overlay will also be available as a certification_target in a future release. Currently wired as data_classification triggered by DC-AI.
description: ISO/IEC 42001 AI Management System Standard overlay. The ISO 27001 equivalent for AI. Provides requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an AI management system (AIMS). Activated by AI training data declarations.

reporting_obligations.assessment_type: Certification audit by accredited certification body. Stage 1 (documentation review) and Stage 2 (implementation audit). Surveillance audits annually. Recertification every 3 years.
reporting_obligations.reporting_entity: Accredited certification body. Audit results reported to management for management review (Clause 9.3).

human_oversight_mandates.description: ISO 42001 does not mandate specific human oversight configurations but requires management review (Clause 9.3), monitoring of AIMS effectiveness (Clause 9.1), and organizational awareness of AI system impacts (Clause 7.3). Human oversight is an outcome of the management system, not a prescriptive requirement.

notes: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 — AI Management System (AIMS) standard, published December 18, 2023. The 'ISO 27001 equivalent for AI' — provides a certifiable management system framework for responsible AI development and use. Structure: Clauses 4-10 (management system requirements) + Annex A (organizational controls, abbreviated A.2-A.6) + Annex B (AI system impact categories). Annex A is organized as: A.2 Policies for AI (governance), A.3 Internal organization (roles), A.4 Resources for AI (data, tools), A.5 Assessing impacts, A.6 AI system lifecycle. Annex A control notation used in this overlay follows ISO 42001 published structure: Cl.X.X for clause-based requirements, A.X.X for Annex A controls. The TECH sub-notation (A.TECH.X.X) used in some prior AKSI drafts is not an official ISO 42001 notation — this overlay uses correct Annex A section references. Certification path: Third-party certification audits by accredited certification bodies (UKAS, DAkkS, etc.). Relationship to ISO 27001: Organizations with existing ISO 27001 certification can use it as a foundation — ISO 42001 adds AI-specific requirements on top of the ISMS. AKSI controls map most densely to ISO 42001 Clause 6 (planning), Clause 8 (operation), and Annex A.
